notes.title: Small update, Back up your saves
notes.content:
Hey All!
Can we please Back up our saves, there is a small update coming

Currently in the game, there is the potential to leave Shar Vahl without Savanna in the party-
this creates issues later in the game if she is not present.

This is going to be fixed so that you cannot leave the town of Shar Vahl without
Magus, Savanna, and Renshi in your party

If we could all please back up our saves ( check the forum for instructions)
that way nothing gets messed with permanently

Wolfs Moon Studios

notes.title: Small update coming
notes.content:
Hey everyone,  I am going to be doing a small update soon that will include some small changes.

One of the new additions will be the ability to run while in towns, and in a few other zones that are especially large.   While In game just press escape, and where the always dash is= turn it on.  
Now anytime you can run, you will.

No  saves should be impacted by this, but remember they are easy to get back should they appear invisible on you.

Please continue to actively send your feedback - Things you like/dislike. 
THanks a bunch!

Wolfs Moon Studios
